title: Chilli Root Knot Nematode on Chilli

Header: Chilli Root Knot Nematode on Chilli
Meloidogyne spp. Singala: Mul geta Wattapanu Haniya. Tamil: Milakai ver mudichchu noi

Prevention: Use nematode-free seedlings as planting materials.
Avoid soil media for nursery preparation
Use sterilized media for nursery bed preparation
Avoid infected field for nursery bed preparation
Before planting observe the roots of seedlings
Use recommended fertilizer to maintain healthy plants
Plant rotation with resistant plants (Leeks, Cabbage, Mustard)
Avoid surface irrigation and used drip irrigation to avoid spread the nematode from infected field to healthy field
Monitoring: Regular observation of field from seedling stage to mature plants for the characteristic symptoms of root knot nematodes
Sample the roots of mature plants to look for root knots
Premature wilting in spots within the field 2.
Fruiting and flowering in vegetative stages. 4.
Plant death at mid to late stage
Direct Control: Remove the infected plants and residues
Apply poultry manure instead of cow dung
Apply compost as nematode-free organic fertilizer
Apply poultry manure instead of other organic fertilizers
Deep plough and expose to direct sunlight
Add green manure with a repellent crop to the affected field, such as: sun hemp, adathoda, Tithonia , Gliricidia , Neem leaves, Calotrophis leaves
Restrictions: There are no recommended chemicals to control nematodes.
